title: Weather lookup bslib additions
description:
Adds some new fun bslib features to the weather-lookup app. 

In addition to the already used bootswatch theming, the app will now update the theme dynamically based on the current city's average daily temperature for the current day. If it falls below a threshold (settable by the user) then the app uses a "cold" blue theme, if it is above it uses a "hot" red theme, otherwise it just uses the default colors for the flatly bootswatch. 

The most tricky part of this new code is the updating of the plot caching key to make sure the plot respects the current theme. This was done by referencing the session object's foreground color of the plot:
```r
output$weather_plot <- renderPlot({
  ...
}) %>% 
  bindCache(input$city, session$clientData$output_weather_plot_fg, sizePolicy = sizeGrowthRatio(width = 400, height = 600))
```
